detail: Calibrate the exit-8 preflight projection: measure per-turn wall from existing rows-*.jsonl, replace turns x --turn-wall-cap with turns x --projected-turn-wall (default 60s) plus --projected-from <rows.jsonl> p90; keep --max-wall/exit 8 and the live --turn-wall-cap abort unchanged. OFFLINE, zero inference requests.

experiments/ptr-engine/measure/rows-cell-pointer-stable-20261026T145758Z.jsonl 6 usable rows thinking=auto: p50=129.1s p90=427.7s mean=190.9s ratio=0.0288 s/completion_token. Pooled thinking on/auto n=9: p50=218.2 p90=682.7 mean=286.5. Pooled thinking off/absent n=960: p50=2.9 p90=38.1 mean=27.5 ratio=0.0338. Wall/token stable ~0.03 in every regime. Six rows are one arm on one day = anecdotes, not a distribution.

Default projected turn wall 60s (above p50 of every non-thinking-on regime, far below the 180s abort threshold); --projected-from lets a same-arm row file supply its p90. Preflight prints projected_wall~=N s AND cap-per-turn 180 -> worst case M. Decision: test_guards.py check (d) is pinned to --projected-turn-wall 180 with its assertion moved to projected_wall~=8640s, because its old expectation (48 turns refused at the default) is exactly the defect being removed; disclosed as a deviation from the declared write paths — no guard behaviour changed, exit 8 still fires and still precedes the runner.
tests/test_projection_calibration.py 4/4 passed (a 2880 admitted, b 8640 exit 8, c p90 from file named, d live turn aborted at 0.4s and 1.2s). tests/test_guards.py 6/6 GREEN.

docs/PROJECTION-CALIBRATION.md and measure/PROJECTION.json written. Under --max-wall 3600 at the 60s default: 12 turns=720s admitted, 48=2880s admitted, 60=3600s admitted; at 180s worst case 48=8640s refused. The 4-arm x 60-turn x 3-rep comparison is 180 requests per cell = 10800s at 60s/turn, so it needs --max-wall >= 10800 rather than a disabled guard.
